post.description: Creates a record. Answers 403 for a resource that doesn't allow it, and 422 naming any field that is read-only, hidden or unknown.

get.description: Reads one record by its _key. Answers 404 for a key that doesn't decode or a record that doesn't exist.

put.description: Changes some fields of a record; the body is partial. Answers 403 for a resource that doesn't allow it, and 422 naming any field that is read-only, hidden or unknown.

delete.description: Deletes a record. Answers 409 while other records still point at it, and 403 for a resource that doesn't allow it.
